decision: Rejected as production implementation: still slower than Python and about 19 GiB process RSS. No MKL packed provider retained in production.
accuracy: Unpacked host reference kept disabled for the diagnostic provider. Both logits and action outputs checked at 2e-3 + abs(reference)*2e-5. Maximum difference 0.001220703125. Synthetic comparisons passed 1e-4 at rows 1/3/7/8/9/16/64/65.
measurement: One full-model run: L8 B1 99.694 ms, L16 B1 107.390 ms, L64 B1 162.436 ms, L8 B8 159.583 ms. Not a repeated model speedup claim.
memory: Observed process RSS 19034120 KiB during benchmark. Blocked library pack size greatly exceeds raw weights; reported in micro files.
reproduce: Replay model_diagnostic.patch on base. Set LAYA_MKL_DIAGNOSTIC_LIBRARY to supplied MKL library; benchmark release with RAYON_NUM_THREADS=8, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE. Torch 2.14.1 CPU bundled MKL 2024.2 was used for diagnostics only.
